name: mikro-rust-configurator
description: NECTO-style MCU and Rust project configuration for mikroSDK-like workspaces.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: The extension generates project files and can execute Rust/OpenOCD/probe-rs tools, so the workspace must be trusted.

mikroRust.rootPath.description: Root containing the core, sdk, and application/database folders. Empty means the current workspace folder. Relative paths are resolved from the workspace folder.

mikroRust.databasePath.description: Path to the MCU SQLite database, relative to Mikro Rust root unless absolute.

mikroRust.corePath.description: Path to the Rust core repository/folder, relative to Mikro Rust root unless absolute.

mikroRust.sdkPath.description: Path to the mikroSDK-like Rust workspace, relative to Mikro Rust root unless absolute.

mikroRust.corePlatform.description: Platform subpath used below core/ and sdk/targets/. The supplied application uses arm/stm32.

mikroRust.pythonPath.description: Optional Python executable used for SQLite access. Empty enables automatic python3/python/py detection and sqlite3 CLI fallback.

mikroRust.installRustTargetOnConfigure.description: Run rustup target add after a successful configuration.

mikroRust.openocdPath.description: OpenOCD executable used by diagnostics/debug integration.

mikroRust.gdbPath.description: ARM GDB executable used for diagnostics/raw debug fallback.

mikroRust.cortexDebugExtensionId.description: Optional VS Code debug extension used for graphical OpenOCD/GDB debugging.

scripts.check: node --check src/extension.js && node --check src/configurationEngine.js && node --check src/database.js && node --check src/dashboard.js && node --check src/configurationPanel.js && node --check src/process.js
